name: MedTech Solutions Surgical Precision Gloves
description:
Ultra-thin surgical gloves with embedded haptic feedback sensors that amplify the wearer's sense of touch by a factor of twelve. Every texture, every pulse, every micro-variation in tissue is transmitted to the wearer's fingertips with crystalline clarity. The gloves are single-use, sterile-packaged, and decompose within 72 hours of opening.

Used by surgeons, augmentation installers, and forensic examiners who need to feel what they cannot see. The amplified sensitivity makes wearing them in casual environments overwhelming — every surface becomes a flood of tactile information.
what_it_says: Your hands need to feel things at a resolution that would overwhelm a normal nervous system.
story_hooks: A forensic examiner wearing Precision Gloves discovers a texture pattern on a victim's skin that shouldn't be there — micro-branding invisible to the naked eye, spelling out a serial number.
